events.title: Year End Trip 2026
events.sub: First 60: $550 single, $1,500 a couple · pay Jerry by Zelle or Venmo to hold a spot
events.time: Dec 28 to Jan 1 · 4 nights · arrive around 6 PM MT
events.whereNote: Five-star hotel downtown · Jerry has prepaid the room block
events.about:
Our year-end trip is four nights in Scottsdale, Arizona, at a five-star hotel downtown. We arrive Monday, Dec 28 around 6 PM and fly home on New Year's Day.

To qualify: bring 3 prospects to a BP, or launch 1 partner, by year end. Qualifiers get special activities on the trip, and 3/6 and above also get dinner with JL leadership. Qualifiers who can't make the trip get a special Q&A with our upline instead.

Jerry has prepaid the room block, so the first 60 people get his rate: $550 for a single, $1,500 for a couple, for all four nights. The rate goes up after the first 60. Pay Jerry by Zelle or Venmo to hold your spot, then book your flight into Phoenix Sky Harbor (PHX).

Every activity below is optional and you pay your own. Prices are per person.
days: Old Town Scottsdale, walking distance from the hotel. Split the bill
Arizona's #1 public course, pure desert. $239 resort rate, club rental extra
Desert Botanical Garden lit by thousands of candles, holidays only. $40 to $45
Float over the Sonoran Desert, champagne toast after. $209. Same morning as the hike, pick one
Team photo at the top. A hard climb, bring water. Free
Sonoran Desert jeep tour at sunset
2 to 3 hours off-road among the saguaro cactus. $145 to $175
An astronomer and telescopes at a dark-sky spot, 2.5 hours. Bring a jacket. Price to be confirmed
Home of the WM Phoenix Open and its famous 16th hole. $200 to $350, club rental extra
Last year's most popular activity. Price to be confirmed
Team dinner, karaoke, then the countdown in Old Town. Price to be confirmed
Comedy remake, singing group and dance group. To be finalized at the next team call

# Where we are
Proposed on the team call in mid-November: three shows from our team. We finalize at the next team call. Come with your ideas and which show you want to join. Have a new show idea, like a magic act? Propose it and Johnny submits it.

# 1. Comedy remake (partners outside New York)
- We remake a classic story with business and product jokes, the way the Chinese conferences and the Chinese New Year gala do their skits
- A video of about 10 minutes carries the whole show: the scenes, the voices, the music and the subtitles, all recorded ahead of time
- On stage we act it out in costume and lip-sync to the video. Nobody has to memorize lines
- Starting idea: Snow White. "Mirror, mirror, who is the most beautiful?" sets up Artistry, and the poisoned apple becomes our Vitamin C apple demo
- Any other story works too if it fits more jokes, products and business
- The real work is the script: remaking the story so it is funny. Prep happens remotely before the trip
- Bring a costume for your role. Your Halloween costume works
- New York partners who love the idea can join too

# 2. Singing group
- Raymond, Johnson, Ding and William (to confirm)
- Something hype and exciting, in English. No slow love songs
- Starting idea: a Bruno Mars song

# 3. Dance group (New York partners)
- A mashup of the 2026 TikTok dances, done in one shot
- We live close, so we meet up in person to practice
- Needed: someone to collect the dances, someone to plan the practices, and someone to mix the music into one track
- The bar is good and cool, not cringe. If it is not good, we don't do it

# Keep it in proportion
Show prep is not productive time. Keep your DTMs going every week, and get your minimum game plan done this month.
Most flights leave around 6 AM, so stay close to the hotel on New Year's Eve
faq: How do I qualify?

Bring 3 prospects to a BP, or launch 1 partner, by year end. Qualifiers get special activities on the trip, and if you are 3/6 or above, dinner with JL leadership. If you qualify but can't come, we add a special Q&A with our upline for you.
How do I hold my spot?
Pay Jerry by Zelle or Venmo: $550 single or $1,500 a couple, for all 4 nights. Jerry prepaid the room block, so you pay him, not the hotel.
Which airport?
Phoenix Sky Harbor (PHX). Land by about 6 PM on Dec 28 and fly home Jan 1. Send Johnny your flight once it's booked.
Are the activities included?
No. Every activity is optional and you pay your own. The prices on the itinerary are per person.
What's the hotel called?
Jerry hasn't posted the name yet. It's a five-star hotel in downtown Scottsdale.
What should I pack?
Desert days are mild and the nights get cold, so bring layers and a jacket, plus shoes you can hike in and sunscreen.

How to run skin
Read their check-in first, so you already know their routine
Hat and sunglasses off, hair back, eyes closed while the light is on. It is safe and non-invasive, and they see what you see in the mirror
Ask if they are wearing sunscreen or makeup. Sunscreen on? Test ours on half the face
Read the colors: even blue is balanced, yellow is oil, white is dry, tiny orange dots are congestion, dark patches are pigmentation. Compare with the sides of the face
Dark spot? Ask if they used to have acne there
Match what you see on the sheet. No routine at all? One Hydrating Mask, once or twice a week
How to run hair
Offer it after skin
Blue light magnifier on the front, top, sides and back. Lift long hair
Look for oil or yellow buildup, flakes, redness, a single thin strand per pore, split ends
Recommend by what you see. It does not have to be one line
Split ends: dip them in the Intensive Repair Hair Treatment and let them feel the difference
